# Missingness grid stress

Ledger across strata and Observable policies. Heavy Monte Carlo recovery stays
in package unit tests and `scripts/stress_harness/`; this notebook asserts
finite estimands, strategy metadata, and certificate / mechanism guards.

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-setup
#| warning: false

using Pkg
const PKG_ROOT = normpath(joinpath(@__DIR__, "..", ".."))
const BOOK_ROOT = normpath(joinpath(PKG_ROOT, "..", ".."))
if isfile(joinpath(BOOK_ROOT, "Project.toml"))
    Pkg.activate(BOOK_ROOT)

using CausalDynamics
```

## Structural — certificates and generative masks

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-structural
#| warning: false

rows = NamedTuple[]
g = DiGraph(3)
add_edge!(g, 1, 2)
add_edge!(g, 1, 3)
add_edge!(g, 2, 3)
names = Dict(1 => :W, 2 => :A, 3 => :Y)
for (regime, cond, expect_id) in (
    (:mcar, Symbol[], true),
    (:mar, [:W], true),
    (:mar, Symbol[], false),
    (:mnar, [:W], false),
)
    spec = MissingnessSpec(:Y; regime = regime, conditioning_set = cond)
    cert = certify_missingness(spec)
    id = identify(g, TotalEffectQuery(:A, :Y); node_names = names, missingness = spec)
    push!(rows, (
        cell = "Structural",
        regime = String(regime),
        cert_ok = cert.identifiable,
        expect = expect_id,
        causal_id = id.identifiable,
        miss_id = id.missingness.identifiable,
    ))
    @assert cert.identifiable == expect_id
    @assert id.identifiable  # backdoor separate from missingness ID
end
structural_ledger = DataFrame(rows)
println(structural_ledger)
structural_ledger
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-mechanism-oracle
#| warning: false

n = 200
W = randn(StableRNG(90), n)
Y = 0.6 .* W .+ randn(StableRNG(91), n)
out, mask = apply_missingness_mechanism(
    Dict(:W => W, :Y => Y),
    MissingnessSpec(:Y; regime = :mar, conditioning_set = [:W]);
    intercept = -0.8, coefficients = Dict(:W => 1.0), rng = StableRNG(92),
)
rate = miss_rates(mask)[:Y]
@assert 0.05 < rate < 0.85
mechanism_ledger = DataFrame(regime = ["mar"], miss_rate = [rate], n = [n])
println(mechanism_ledger)
mechanism_ledger
```

## Dynamical — sequential / survival / incomplete panel

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-dynamical
#| warning: false

dyn_rows = NamedTuple[]
# Sequential MAR Y
rng = StableRNG(93)
n = 80
W = randn(rng, n)
A1 = 0.5 .* W .+ randn(rng, n)
L1 = 0.3 .* A1 .+ randn(rng, n)
A2 = 0.4 .* L1 .+ randn(rng, n)
Y = 0.5 .* A2 .+ 0.3 .* A1 .+ 0.2 .* W .+ randn(rng, n)
df_seq = DataFrame(W = W, A1 = A1, L1 = L1, A2 = A2, Y = Y)
df_seq.Y = Vector{Union{Float64, Missing}}(df_seq.Y)
p_miss = 1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ exp.(-(-1.2 .+ 0.8 .* W)))
for i in 1:n
    rand(rng) < p_miss[i] && (df_seq.Y[i] = missing)
end
shift = additive_shift_policy(; scale = "raw", lower_q = 0.0, upper_q = 1.0)
for strat in (:drop, :ipcw, :impute, :ipcw_impute)
    r = run_sequential_lmtp(
        df_seq, [:A1, :A2], :Y;
        baseline = [:W], time_vary = [Symbol[], [:L1]],
        delta = 0.25, shift = shift, folds = 2,
        learners = (:glm, :mean), handle_missing = strat, rng = StableRNG(93),
    )
    @assert isfinite(r.estimate)
    push!(dyn_rows, (family = "sequential", strategy = String(strat), estimate = r.estimate))
end

# Survival MAR terminal S_T
df_s, truth_s = CausalTargeted.simulate_discrete_survival_mtp(100; T = 2, rng = StableRNG(94))
Sh = truth_s.surv[end]
rng = StableRNG(95)
df_s[!, Sh] = Vector{Union{Float64, Missing}}(df_s[!, Sh])
p_miss = 1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ exp.(-(-1.2 .+ 0.7 .* df_s.W)))
for i in 1:nrow(df_s)
    rand(rng) < p_miss[i] && (df_s[i, Sh] = missing)
end
for strat in (:drop, :ipcw)
    r = run_survival_lmtp(
        df_s, truth_s.treatments, truth_s.surv;
        baseline = [:W], delta = 0.25, folds = 2,
        learners = (:glm, :mean), handle_missing = strat, rng = StableRNG(96),
    )
    @assert isfinite(r.estimate)
    push!(dyn_rows, (family = "survival_MAR_ST", strategy = String(strat), estimate = r.estimate))
end

# Survival with censoring columns (complete S_T path — distinct object)
df_c, truth_c = CausalTargeted.simulate_discrete_survival_mtp(100; T = 2, rng = StableRNG(97))
r_c = run_survival_lmtp(
    df_c, truth_c.treatments, truth_c.surv;
    baseline = [:W], delta = 0.25, folds = 2,
    learners = (:glm, :mean), handle_missing = :drop, rng = StableRNG(98),
)
@assert isfinite(r_c.estimate)
push!(dyn_rows, (family = "survival_complete", strategy = "drop", estimate = r_c.estimate))

dynamical_ledger = DataFrame(dyn_rows)
println(dynamical_ledger)
dynamical_ledger
```

## Observable — point LMTP / g-comp / mediation / posterior

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-observable
#| warning: false

obs_rows = NamedTuple[]
df_y, truth_y = CausalTargeted.simulate_missing_outcome_mtp(180; rng = StableRNG(99))
sdA = std(skipmissing(df_y.A))
δ = 1.0 * sdA
te = truth_y.effects(δ).te
for strat in (:drop, :ipcw, :impute, :ipcw_impute)
    grid = run_lmtp_grid(
        df_y, :A, :Y; baseline = [:W], deltas = [δ],
        folds = 2, learners_outcome = (:glm, :mean), learners_trt = (:glm, :mean),
        parallel = false, simultaneous = false, cache_nuisances = false,
        rng = StableRNG(99), shift_scale = "raw", handle_missing = strat,
    )
    ψ = Float64(only(grid.est))
    @assert isfinite(ψ)
    @assert missingness_metadata(grid).strategy === strat
    push!(obs_rows, (
        family = "lmtp_miss_Y", strategy = String(strat), estimate = ψ, abs_err = abs(ψ - te),
    ))
end

df_w, truth_w = CausalTargeted.simulate_missing_covariate_mtp(180; rng = StableRNG(100))
te_w = truth_w.effects(δ).te
for strat in (:drop, :impute)
    grid = run_lmtp_grid(
        df_w, :A, :Y; baseline = [:W], deltas = [δ],
        folds = 2, learners_outcome = (:glm, :mean), learners_trt = (:glm, :mean),
        parallel = false, simultaneous = false, cache_nuisances = false,
        rng = StableRNG(100), shift_scale = "raw", handle_missing = strat,
    )
    ψ = Float64(only(grid.est))
    @assert isfinite(ψ)
    push!(obs_rows, (
        family = "lmtp_miss_W", strategy = String(strat), estimate = ψ, abs_err = abs(ψ - te_w),
    ))
end

for strat in (:drop, :ipcw, :impute, :ipcw_impute)
    r = run_gcomp(
        df_y, :A, :Y; covariates = [:W], delta = δ,
        folds = 2, learners = (:glm, :mean), n_boot = 0,
        rng = StableRNG(101), handle_missing = strat,
    )
    @assert isfinite(r.estimate)
    push!(obs_rows, (
        family = "gcomp_miss_Y", strategy = String(strat), estimate = r.estimate,
        abs_err = abs(r.estimate - te),
    ))
end

df_m, _ = CausalMediation.simulate_mediation(160; rng = StableRNG(102))
rng = StableRNG(103)
df_m.Y = Vector{Union{Float64, Missing}}(df_m.Y)
p_miss = 1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ exp.(-(-1.2 .+ 0.9 .* df_m.W)))
for i in 1:nrow(df_m)
    rand(rng) < p_miss[i] && (df_m.Y[i] = missing)
end
for strat in (:drop, :ipcw, :impute, :ipcw_impute)
    tab = CausalMediation.run_mediation_scalar(
        df_m, :A, :Y;
        covar = [:W], mediators = [:M],
        folds = 2, n_mc = 6, estimator = :onestep,
        learners = (:glm, :mean), handle_missing = strat, rng = StableRNG(104),
    )
    te_m = only(tab[tab.effect .== "TE", :estimate])
    @assert isfinite(te_m)
    push!(obs_rows, (family = "mediation_miss_Y", strategy = String(strat), estimate = te_m, abs_err = NaN))
end

cert = certify_missingness(MissingnessSpec(:Y; regime = :mar, conditioning_set = [:W]))
draws = impute_posterior(
    df_y, :Y, [:W]; treatment = :A, certificate = cert, n_draws = 6, rng = StableRNG(105),
)
grid_p = run_lmtp_grid(
    df_y, :A, :Y; baseline = [:W], deltas = [δ],
    folds = 2, learners_outcome = (:glm, :mean), learners_trt = (:glm, :mean),
    parallel = false, simultaneous = false, cache_nuisances = false,
    rng = StableRNG(105), shift_scale = "raw", imputation = draws,
)
ψ_p = Float64(only(grid_p.est))
@assert isfinite(ψ_p)
@assert missingness_metadata(grid_p).strategy === :posterior_gaussian_mar
push!(obs_rows, (family = "lmtp_posterior", strategy = "posterior_gaussian_mar", estimate = ψ_p, abs_err = abs(ψ_p - te)))

observable_ledger = DataFrame(obs_rows)
println(observable_ledger)
observable_ledger
```
